pages.title: Finding Prometheum
pages.text: Default deposits: Overworld, Y 0 to 64. Veins target up to 6 blocks, with 10 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 1. Some deposits also have biome restrictions.

pages.title: Working Prometheum
pages.text: Smelt Prometheum Ore or Prometheum Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 121 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 2.$(br)Mining efficiency: 4.7.$(br)Material damage bonus: 2.4.$(br)Enchantability: 14.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 2, chestplate 2, leggings 2, boots 1.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 0.5.$(br)Enchantability: 14.

pages.title: Armor: Freyr
pages.text: Shifting affects nearby crops and grass growth giving it a boost at the cost of a bit of armor durability.

pages.title: Photosynthesis
pages.text: Item durability regenerates slowly overtime when under direct sunlight.

pages.title: Hoe: Harvest
pages.text: When harvested with this hoe: leaves, crops and grass drops are increased.
